title: Width of the Reviewable Excess Withdrawal Fee Pool by Card Relationship
content:
The reviewable fee pool on an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts widens with the owner's card relationship. Two facts are read from the owner's card under Personal Credit Cards: the count of card purchases posted in the twelve calendar months ending on the review date, and the unredeemed rewards points the card carries.

**Where 6 or more card purchases posted in that window and the card carries at least 3000 unredeemed rewards points**, the reviewable fee pool is the excess withdrawal fees posted to the account in those twelve calendar months.

**Where 3, 4 or 5 card purchases posted in that window and the card carries at least 3000 unredeemed rewards points**, the reviewable fee pool is the excess withdrawal fees posted in the three calendar months ending on the review date.

**Where fewer than 3 card purchases posted in that window, or the card carries fewer than 3000 unredeemed rewards points**, the pool stays as the excess withdrawal fees posted in the one calendar month ending on the review date.

### A worked case on hypothetical inputs

Take a savings account carrying excess withdrawal fees of 10.00 USD in the one calendar month ending on the review date, 30.00 USD across the three calendar months ending on that date, and 90.00 USD across the twelve calendar months ending on it.

With 7 card purchases in the window and 5000 unredeemed points, the pool is 90.00 USD. With 4 purchases and the same points, the pool is 30.00 USD. With 2 purchases, or with 2500 unredeemed points at any purchase count, the pool is 10.00 USD.

### Boundary of the counts

A count of exactly 6 card purchases falls in the widest band, a count of exactly 3 in the middle band, and a count of 2, 1 or 0 in the narrowest. Exactly 3000 unredeemed rewards points satisfies the points condition; 2999 does not.
